map.：C-f/C-b 前后字符，C-n/C-p 上下行，C-a/C-e 行首/行尾，: : C-f / C-b move by character, C-n / C-p by line, C-a / C-e to the start / end of the line, and M-< / M-> to the start / end of the buffer.
map.：C-k 删至行尾，C-y 粘贴（yank），C-/ 撤销，C-s 增量搜索，M: : C-k kills to the end of the line, C-y yanks, C-/ undoes, C-s searches incrementally, and M-% runs query-replace.
map.：C-x C-f 打开，C-x C-s 保存，C-x b 切换缓冲区，C-x 2: : C-x C-f opens a file, C-x C-s saves it, C-x b switches buffers, and C-x 2/3 splits the window.

map.不必一次记全，先掌握十来个高频键，其余用到再查。可开启 which-key 之类: There is no need to learn them all at once: master a dozen high-frequency bindings first and look up the rest as you need them. A hint package such as which-key shows the possible continuations in real time, or you can switch to evil / spacemacs to keep your Vim habits while you transition gradually. Muscle memory takes time, and using the editor beats memorising the whole table.
